items.title: Alibaba’s (BABA) AI Growth Prospects Remain Masked by Short-Term Challenges
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) offers promising artificial intelligence (AI) growth prospects, but its short-term struggles continue to weigh on the stock.
